run_omnivore_training: run the omnivore multimodal model training loop with image, video, and rgbd modalities
evaluate_omnivore_model: evaluate a trained omnivore model on validation data with clip and video-level accuracy
train_one_epoch_omnivore: train one epoch of the omnivore model with gradient accumulation for video inputs
configure_omnivore_args: configure training arguments including optimizer, lr scheduler, and modality options for omnivore
resume_omnivore_checkpoint: resume omnivore training from a saved checkpoint with model, optimizer, and EMA state
